# Lab 12.2: Logistic Regression Classification

## What We Are Going to Do
Train a classifier that predicts whether a person earns more than 50K, then read the confusion matrix and ROC curve.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Train the model.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.income_lr
OPTIONS (
  model_type = 'LOGISTIC_REG',
  input_label_cols = ['income_bracket'],
  auto_class_weights = TRUE
) AS
SELECT age, workclass, education, marital_status, occupation, hours_per_week, sex, income_bracket
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ml_datasets.census_adult_income`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Evaluate.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT precision, recall, accuracy, f1_score, roc_auc
FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL lab12.income_lr);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Confusion matrix at different thresholds.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT * FROM ML.CONFUSION_MATRIX(MODEL lab12.income_lr, STRUCT(0.5 AS threshold));
SELECT * FROM ML.CONFUSION_MATRIX(MODEL lab12.income_lr, STRUCT(0.7 AS threshold));</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   A higher threshold means fewer positive predictions: precision goes up, recall goes down.

4. **[Console] ROC curve in the UI.** Open the model's **Evaluation** tab. Move the **threshold** slider and watch precision, recall and the confusion matrix change.

5. **[SQL] Predict with probabilities.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT predicted_income_bracket, predicted_income_bracket_probs, age, occupation
FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL lab12.income_lr,
  (SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.ml_datasets.census_adult_income` LIMIT 5));</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **[CLI] Export the ROC curve points.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv \
'SELECT threshold, recall, false_positive_rate FROM ML.ROC_CURVE(MODEL lab12.income_lr) ORDER BY threshold' &gt; roc.csv
head roc.csv</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| ROC AUC | Around 0.85–0.9 |
| Threshold | Trades precision for recall |
| Probabilities | One per class |
| Class weights | Balance the rarer `>50K` class |
